close_reason: Verified in code — implementation matches decision exactly.
description: The Mdn struct uses the field name extensionFields (matching draft-ietf-jmap-mdn-17 §2, the normative definition). The §3.1 example in the same draft incorrectly uses 'extension'. The choice is explicitly documented in both the field's doc comment and a dedicated unit test (extension_fields_wire_name) that asserts the serialized key is 'extensionFields'. Without this deliberate choice, code derived from the §3.1 example would silently produce uninteroperable wire output.
title: DECISION: extensionFields uses §2 normative wire name, not §3.1 example
